messages:
Gabe Nwosu: Heads-up — OrionGrid dropped sharply this week. WAU down ~54% and active seats 27 -> 7. CRM note: product lead moved teams and a short POC with SaffronAI started last Monday. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/d/OrionGrid/health 
Hannah Li: ouch. Any signs of infra regressions or deploys?
Gabe Nwosu: infra looks clean. No errors. Decline begins 2026-07-08.
Marco Sato: competitor POC + new PM = classic churn vector. Recommend immediate triage: 1) 15-min intro with new PM, 2) infra/usage brief for the call, 3) targeted recovery offer (seat buffer + migration assist).
Priyanka Rao: agreed. Can someone pull a 14-day seat & token slice for an exec snapshot? Gabe?
Gabe Nwosu: posting quick SQL for Marco/infra:
```
SELECT date, count(distinct user_id) AS active_seats, sum(tokens) AS tokens
FROM usage.events
WHERE org = 'oriongrid' AND date >= current_date - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date DESC;
```
Marco Sato: running now. No p95 drift; KV cache hit rate steady. Behavior change likely.
triage-bot: Meeting scheduled: "OrionGrid - PM recovery check" on 2026-07-13 11:00 PT — invites: PM, Gabe, Hannah, Marco :calendar:
Hannah Li: can you draft a 3-line outreach to PM: 1) what we observed, 2) ask about Saffron goals + blockers, 3) offer a 15-min technical Q&A and 30-day seat buffer? keep it light.
Gabe Nwosu: draft sent.
Priyanka Rao: pricing move suggestion: offer 30-day free seats + one migration office-hour, escalate to 60 days + 10% credit if they commit to a 6-month renewed term within 45 days. I'll model cost.
Marco Sato: technical ask: verify if any requests routed to fallback pools or lower model variants during the window. I'll check routing logs and model variant histogram.
Hannah Li: I'll prepare a one-slide ROI showing token efficiency gains and 2 quick wins relevant to their use cases.
Gabe Nwosu: action items: A) Outreach & agenda (Gabe), B) Pricing/credit proposal (Priyanka), C) Infra/variant run + brief (Marco), D) One-slide ROI (Hannah). Timeline: outreach today, infra brief EOD tomorrow, pricing by meeting.
Marco Sato: noted. If Saffron offers feature X that customers like, surface migration mitigations and a short demo to close parity gaps.
Priyanka Rao: will include migration assist language in the proposal.
Gabe Nwosu: pinged PM thread with agenda + link to low-effort wins doc. Will update here after reply. :eyes: 
Hannah Li: keep high-touch for now. (reaction :thumbsup: 2834512478)
